description: A minimal record attesting that a payment was performed, signed by the broker. Carries only status, broker identity, timestamps, and signatures by default; the recipient `subject` is optional and absent unless the issuer opts in to publishing it. Line item details live in the `network.attested.payment.initiate` input, not on the record itself; carts and entitlements reference this record by uri.

subject.description: Optional DID of the payment recipient. Absent by default; Broker expected to retain the recipient information internally. Setting this on the record makes the recipient publicly visible.

broker.description: DID of the broker that issued and is settling this payment.

signatures.description: Broker attestation(s). Each entry is either an inline `network.attested.signature` or a `com.atproto.repo.strongRef` pointing at a remote `network.attested.proof` record. The canonical signing payload covers `status`, `broker`, `createdAt`, plus `subject` and `completedAt` when present. Mutating any of those fields invalidates every signature in this array.
